messages:
Caroline: Quick heads up — Meridian Bank signed LOI but needs SOC2 artifacts + NDA + a short acknowledgement letter for a SOC2 gap while our Type II is still being finalized. They want docs by Tue EOD. Can we mobilize?

Ben (InfoSec): We have hosted Type II in flight (ETA 2025-02-15). We should not assert Type II coverage for Dedicated/Private yet. Propose: signed NDA -> share hosted attestation + CAIQ, plus a one-paragraph acknowledgement noting Dedicated outside current scope and listing compensating controls. Needs legal sign-off. :shield:

Maria (Legal): I can prepare a signed ack letter and attach the latest Type I artifacts. Important: clarify whether Meridian expects Dedicated coverage — wording differs significantly.

Caroline: They explicitly asked for "hosted API and dedicated capacity" coverage. They said the deal timeline is tight and asked whether a bridge attestation could suffice.

Ben (InfoSec): We can't falsely claim coverage. Offer to: (1) supply hosted attestation, (2) provide CAIQ and control evidence for Dedicated, (3) include roadmap language for Type II coverage of Dedicated. Recommend calling out encryption (KMS/HSM), isolation measures, and logging/retention.

Alex (Solutions Eng): POC note — they want SAML SSO into a sandbox Dedicated tenant. We can spin a non-prod tenant with SAML for a short window. Infrastructure lead needs 24hrs. Any volunteer to provision?

Jen (Eng-Infra): I can provision a staging Dedicated-like tenant tomorrow morning if we get the customer's IdP metadata and a contact. Please ensure the ack letter flags that the environment is non-prod.

Caroline: I'll request IdP metadata and confirm the exact scope. Maria, can you draft a concise ack paragraph today that avoids overstating coverage but reassures them?

Maria (Legal): Draft below — open to edits.

Maria (Legal): "To whom it may concern: Redwood Inference confirms our SOC 2 Type II (hosted API) covers the controls described in the attached report. Dedicated and Private deployments are not included in the current attestation period. Redwood employs documented isolation, encryption, and monitoring controls for Dedicated deployments and can provide targeted technical evidence under NDA. Redwood is targeting Type II attestation for Dedicated deployments in Q2, subject to completion of internal readiness and audit validation. For technical follow-ups contact sec@redwood.ai."

Ben (InfoSec): Looks good. Add a link to the CAIQ summary and a one-page control mapping. Also include encryption-at-rest and in-transit notes and KMS usage. :+1:

Caroline: Meridian wants an NDA before we share internal docs. Which NDA template do we use?

Thomas (Sales Ops): Use mutual NDA template v3.2. Bridge-bot: uploaded file redwood-nda-mutual-3.2.pdf -> https://files.redwood.ai/nda/redwood-nda-mutual-3.2.pdf

Caroline: I'll send the mutual NDA plus the ack paragraph and CAIQ link. If they sign quickly, Jen can provision the sandbox Tue and we can share hosted artifacts under NDA. Ben, can you validate CAIQ is current?

Ben (InfoSec): I'll confirm CAIQ and attach a one-pager mapping controls to SOC criteria by EOD today.

Jen (Eng-Infra): For provisioning I'll need a PO/POC ticket, tenant name, list of test accounts and expected load. If they want heavy load testing we should size GPUs now.

Caroline: Noted. Maria, once you sign the rev ack please post the signed PDF in this thread so I can include it in the NDA packet.

Maria (Legal): Signed and uploaded. Bridge-bot: uploaded file redwood-soc2-ack-meridian-signed.pdf -> https://files.redwood.ai/ack/redwood-soc2-ack-meridian-signed.pdf

Caroline: Plan recap: 1) Send NDA + ack paragraph + CAIQ link to Meridian today; 2) Meridian signs NDA -> we share hosted SOC2 artifacts + CAIQ one-pager; 3) If proceeding, Jen provisions sandbox Tue; 4) Sales/procurement to coordinate PO. I'll post Meridian's replies here.

Caroline (2h later): Meridian legal replied asking the ack to state "Dedicated planned for Type II coverage by Q2 and included in the next attestation." Can we commit?

Ben (InfoSec): Avoid hard deadlines. Change to "targeting Q2, subject to audit completion and readiness validation." We shouldn't promise a firm attestation quarter.

Maria (Legal): I'll edit to include that cautious language and request their legal review of the revised phrasing. Uploading revised ack now.

Bridge-bot: uploaded file redwood-soc2-ack-meridian-revised.pdf -> https://files.redwood.ai/ack/redwood-soc2-ack-meridian-revised.pdf

Caroline: Meridian also requested a short bridge call with their InfoSec tomorrow 10:00 PT to review controls. Can we cover?

Ben (InfoSec): I can attend. Alex will handle the architecture/POC talk. Jen can be on standby for infra questions.

Caroline: I'll schedule the call once NDA is signed. Last update for thread.
